queries_run: HubSpot customer concentration risk no single customer 10% revenue 10-K 2025

findings.claim: Solutions Partners 及其轉介客戶約占 2025 年營收 49%（占客戶數約 25%），屬通路集中而非單一客戶集中。
findings.excerpt: Solutions Partners and customers referred to us by our Solutions Partners represented approximately 25% of our Customers as of December 31, 2025, and approximately 49% of our revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025.

findings.claim: 訂閱收入占 98%，多數訂閱期限一年或更短；10-K 信用風險集中段僅列現金、投資、應收帳款，未見單一客戶集中揭露。
findings.excerpt: Most of our Customers’ subscriptions are one year or less in duration.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 搜尋未查到個別客戶占比或客戶信用惡化事件；僅 1 次搜尋，信用/降評/下修指引未另查。
